basics.name: Celine Cabás
basics.label: Data Scientist | BI Analyst | Economist
basics.summary: Data Scientist and Economist with a background in statistics and experience in automating socioeconomic indicators, statistical modeling, and data visualization. Led projects using Python, R, and SQL in both public and private sectors, developing predictive models and interactive Power BI dashboards to support decision-making.

work.name: Sudata
highlights: Developed a predictive real estate pricing model for Resistencia using geospatial data and machine learning techniques to support property valuation decisions of real estate companies.
Designed dashboards in PowerBI, integrating time series forecasting models to improve KPI tracking, operational visibility and real-time decision making.

work.name: Facultad de Ciencias Económicas, Universidad Nacional del Nordeste
highlights: I teach practical applications and conduct simulations of theoretical concepts in key econometrics topics — linear models, probability models, panel data, and time series — using the R programming.

work.name: Dirección Provincial de Información Estadística y Territorial del Chaco
highlights: Developed regional economic indicators, including the Gross Geographic Product (GGP) which transitioned from annual to quarterly publication, and the Child Rearing Basket for Chaco.
Automated indicator processing workflows in GitHub projects from conception to production with comprehensive documentation, reducing update times.
Created public dynamic reports with Markdown and HTML, enabling currently periodic publication and establishing a periodic reporting system on the provincial statistics website.

work.name: Facultad de Ciencias Exactas, Universidad Nacional del Nordeste
work.position: Professor of Undergraduate Degree in Data Science
highlights: Developed notebooks with practical applications and simulations for the Fundamentals of Probability and Statistics module.
Applied Python to exercises on probability, sampling, statistical inference (confidence intervals and hypothesis tests), linear and logistic regression and kernel density estimation.

work.name: ECOM Chaco S.A.
highlights: Designed and implemented workflows using SQL to process and integrate relational databases from provincial sources, enriching government analyses with multiple complementary data sets.
Developed key socio-economic indicators for public sector decision making on economic activity, employment and provincial infrastructure.
Development of geospatial diagnostic reports at the municipal level in the province of Chaco, combining data on employment, informality, social assistance programs and income characteristics.

work.name: Instituto Provincial de Estadística y Ciencia de Datos del Gobierno de Corrientes
highlights: Designed and implemented the Gross Geographic Product (GGP) estimation project for Corrientes, published on GitHub as the institute's open-source initiative.
Developed automated workflows and time-series forecasting processes to update economic data from national and provincial sources.
Trained technical staff in indicator development, promoting the adoption of reproducible methods across others current projects.

courses: Courseworks in Statistical Inference and Econometrics.
Thesis in progress on 'Propensity score adjustment methods with machine learning models'.
Courseworks in Multivariate Analysis, Time Series and Statistical Consulting.

awards.title: Nobel Prize in Physics
awards.summary: The Nobel Prizes are five separate prizes that, according to Alfred Nobel's will of 1895, are awarded to 'those who, during the preceding year, have conferred the greatest benefit to humankind.'
